subject: Next steps: procurement gating & billing route clarification for LumenCare

--- Message 1/4 ---
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumencare.com>; Rajiv Batra <rbatra@lumencare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement gating & billing route clarification for LumenCare

Hi Sofia / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — really appreciate the practical questions you raised about routing and AP constraints. Per our conversation I wanted to capture the gating items so we can converge on a commercial path (marketplace / card / PO).

Quick recap of what we heard from you:
- Procurement requires vendor onboarding + W-9 and SOC2 evidence prior to payment activation.
- For purchases above $25k, Finance wants a PO; below that they prefer corporate card.
- Marketplace procurement (CloudMart) is preferred if we can publish a listing, as it speeds onboarding for pilot purchases.

What we (Redwood) will do:
- Share a short procurement checklist and SOW template for your legal/ops review (attached).
- Confirm SOC2 report dates and redacted artifacts you can provide to procurement.
- If PO path is required, prepare a one-page commercial summary for your AP team to support PO creation.

Ask for you:
1) Can you confirm the PO threshold (you mentioned $25k — is that firm or a guideline?)
2) Who is the official procurement intake address for vendor forms? (procurement@…?)
3) Are you interested in pursuing the CloudMart listing in parallel, or do you want to finish vendor onboarding first?

Suggested next steps / timeline:
- Today: I’ll send the SOW template + checklist (attached).
- Tue 4/13: Aditya can join a 20-min intake call with your procurement contact to walk the checklist and SOC2 items.
- End of week: we aim to have any redlines or PO requirements noted so Redwood commercial can prepare a PO-friendly invoice.

If this aligns, I’ll set up the intake call for Tue.

Thanks —

Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

--- Message 2/4 ---
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@lumencare.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement gating & billing route clarification for LumenCare

Mina —

Thanks for the follow-up and the SOW. Quick answers from Procurement/FinOps side:
- PO threshold: $25,000 is the formal threshold for PO creation. Anything below we route on our PCard (corporate card).
- Vendor intake: procurement@lumencare.com — please include scanned W-9, SOC2 type II (or Attestation url), and a primary billing contact.
- Marketplace: CloudMart is our preferred path for pilot procurement because it shortens payment and remittance steps, but it requires a public listing and a reconciliation file that matches our ledger fields.

Two constraints to flag:
1) We cannot accept invoices without a Lumencare PO # if the invoice amount will be >= $25k.
2) For vendors onboarded via marketplace, our AP still requires vendor tax and compliance records — it merely streamlines payment.

We’re open to the intake call on Tue 4/13 at 10am PT. Aditya’s presence there would be helpful for technical clarifications.

Sofia Ramos
Head of Procurement | LumenCare Health
sofia.ramos@lumencare.com | +1 617-555-0133

Thanks Sofia — noted. For the intake call I’ll prepare a short checklist that maps Redwood deliverables to the fields CloudMart requires and to the items on your procurement sheet.

A couple of internal clarifications for our side (Mina / Marissa):
- If Lumencare prefers CloudMart, we should confirm which SKU granularity they want for the pilot (by seat / by token budget / flat pilot fee). That determines whether the initial invoice will be > or < $25k.
- If the pilot is expected to cross $25k, we should proactively prepare a PO invoice flow and a shortened SOW that mentions the PO number field.

I’ll attach the intake checklist to the calendar invite and pull the SOC2 summary we can share (redacted).
